caption: The image depicts a monochromatic drawing of a bust sculpture on a pedestal, executed in shades of brown and beige. The bust represents a man with shoulder-length wavy hair, dressed in historical attire consisting of a buttoned coat, a waistcoat, and a neckcloth or cravat. The figure is rendered with detailed facial features and clothing folds. The bust sits on a broad, rectangular plinth featuring carved decorative motifs, including a lyre and branches on the upper section. At the front of the base, the name "Voltaire" is inscribed. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Carved Bust of Voltaire
